# UPSC Mission 90 • Sites Edition

> 90-day UPSC CSE study plan. Each day links to a plain-Markdown file with that day's full lessons.

## Days

- [Day 1: Polity](days/day-01.md): Constitutional development 1773–1947; Directive Principles and welfare state; Important constitutional amendments; Legislative procedure and types of Bills; Supreme Court: jurisdiction and review; Finance Commission and grants; Special provisions for states and Union Territories; Newton laws and conservation laws; Gravitational self energy; Rigid body degrees of freedom and Euler theorem; Main idea and theme
- [Day 2: Polity](days/day-02.md): Constituent Assembly and drafting; Fundamental Duties; Landmark constitutional judgments; Money Bills, Finance Bills and budget process; High Courts and subordinate judiciary; Interstate Council and dispute resolution; Cooperative federalism and challenges; Rotating frames, centrifugal and Coriolis forces; Two-body problem and reduced mass; Angular velocity and rotation matrices basics
- [Day 3: Polity](days/day-03.md): Preamble and constitutional ideals; Amendment procedure Article 368; President: election, powers, impeachment; Parliamentary privileges and motions; Tribunals and justice reforms; Panchayati Raj: 73rd Amendment; Separation of powers and institutional checks; Central-force dynamics and effective potential; Rutherford scattering differential cross-section; Moments of inertia and axis theorems; Inference and implied conclusion; Decoding question and key terms; अपठित गद्यांश: मुख्य भाव
- [Day 4: Polity](days/day-04.md): Features, sources and schedules; Basic Structure doctrine; Vice President and Rajya Sabha chair; Parliamentary committees; Governor and Chief Minister; Urban local government: 74th Amendment; Conservation of angular momentum; CM and lab reference frame conversion; Equation of motion for rotation; Comprehension: main idea and inference
- [Day 5: Polity](days/day-05.md): Citizenship provisions; Union and state territories; Prime Minister and Council of Ministers; Speaker and deputy speaker; State legislature, law-making and powers; Local body finances and devolution; Kepler laws and orbital dynamics; Center of mass of particle system; Rigid molecular rotations (di/tri atomic); Tone, assumption and context
- [Day 6: Polity](days/day-06.md): Fundamental Rights articles 12–35; Emergency: national, state, financial; Cabinet and cabinet committees; Attorney General and CAG; Centre-state legislative relations; Fifth and Sixth Schedules; Gravitational field and potential of spheres; Momentum and angular momentum theorems; Precession, spinning top and gyroscope
- [Day 7: Polity](days/day-07.md): Fundamental Rights limitations and case-law basics; Official language constitutional provisions; Parliament composition and sessions; Constitutional offices and appointment process; Centre-state fiscal relations; Scheduled areas and tribal governance; Gravitational Gauss and Poisson equations; Elastic and inelastic collisions; Logical conclusion from passages
